summary.text: Dan Blue is a Democratic member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 14 since 2009 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as attorney.

paragraphs.text: Blue earned a B.S. in mathematics from North Carolina Central University in 1970 and a J.D. from Duke University Law School in 1973.
He worked at the Law Offices of Terry Sanford from 1973 to 1976 and has been a partner at the Thigpen, Blue, Stephens and Fellers law firm since 1976.
Ballotpedia lists Blue's earlier offices as the North Carolina House of Representatives from 1981 to 2003 and House District 33 from 2006 to 2009.

For the 2025-2026 session, it lists him as a member of the Appropriations on Health and Human Services, Appropriations/Base Budget, Commerce and Insurance, Finance, Judiciary, and Rules and Operations of the Senate committees.
